payout_value_note: $50 to the referrer and $50 to the new member. No limit on the number of $50 rewards.
payout_quote: get $50 for each new member you refer* ... they will ALSO get $50 if they start banking with LPCCU* ... There's NO LIMIT to how many $50 rewards you can earn ... START TODAY!
steps: Member has the friend/family member complete the referral form.

New member (must be eligible for membership; existing primary members and joint owners don't qualify) opens the eligible account: 75 Checking/Share Draft with direct deposit (18+), or Share Savings with $10/month DD/payroll deduction (17 and under).
Both referring and new members must remain in good standing.
Incentive paid within 90 days from the date of the new member's account opening.
catches: No limit on referrals — but the new member must open the eligible account type with direct deposit (adults: 75 Checking with DD; minors: savings with $10/mo DD).
Existing primary members and joint owners opening a new membership do not qualify.
Former members only qualify if their previous account was closed 6+ months before reopen.
Incentive paid within 90 days of account opening — slow payout.
Credit union may modify terms or end the program at any time without notice.
biggest_catch: No limit on rewards, but the friend must open a checking account with direct deposit, and the $50 takes up to 90 days to arrive.
eligibility: Lincoln Park Community CU membership eligibility; friend must be a new member.
timing: Referral form ~5-10 min active; incentive within 90 days of account opening.
